title: Pages answer faster on an account with a long payment history
summary: What your plan lets you do is worked out once each time your payments change, not again on every page.

payload.title: Faster with a long payment history
payload.body: Almost every page checks what your plan lets you do. That used to read your whole payment history each time; now it is worked out once and again only when a payment changes, so decisions, messages and work answer sooner.
